acceptance_by_segment.title: Acceptance criteria by segment
acceptance_by_segment.description: Actual over expected 0.80 to 1.25 overall and in every decile, Gini above 0.45, for every group. On the months after 2024-12, which the model never saw.

ae_by_age_band.title: Actual against expected by loan age
ae_by_age_band.description: Defaults against expectation by seasoning band. On the training half, the data the model was fitted to.

ae_by_decile.title: Actual against expected by decile of predicted risk
ae_by_decile.description: Deciles of the whole training half's exposure. On the training half, the data the model was fitted to.

ae_by_vintage.title: Actual against expected by vintage year
ae_by_vintage.description: Defaults against expectation by year of origination. On the training half, the data the model was fitted to.

ae_by_year.title: Actual against expected by calendar year
ae_by_year.description: Defaults against the model's expectation, year of observation by segment. On the training half, the data the model was fitted to.

backtest_by_decile.title: Backtest by decile of predicted risk
backtest_by_decile.description: Deciles of the test window's exposure. On the months after 2024-12, which the model never saw.

backtest_by_month.title: Backtest by month
backtest_by_month.description: Defaults against expectation by month of observation. On the months after 2024-12, which the model never saw.

book_by_segment.title: The book by month and segment
book_by_segment.description: Loan-months, defaults and prepayments by calendar month, with the default rate and the conditional prepayment rate. The whole book, including the loans the model leaves out.

coefficients.title: Coefficients
coefficients.description: On log survival time: positive lengthens survival and lowers risk. The effect of one standard deviation, exposure-weighted on the training half, puts covariates measured in different units on one scale.

covariates_over_time.title: Macro covariates over time
covariates_over_time.description: The exposure-weighted mean of each time-varying covariate across the loans observed in each month, training half and test window together.

families_vs_km.title: Distribution families against Kaplan-Meier
families_vs_km.description: Each family's fit of the same specification, chained along the realised covariate paths. On the training half, the data the model was fitted to.

km_vs_model.title: Kaplan-Meier against the model, by segment
km_vs_model.description: Survival by loan age, observed and predicted along each loan's realised covariate path, with the Greenwood band. On the training half, the data the model was fitted to.

lending_by_segment.title: Lending by vintage year and segment
lending_by_segment.description: Loans and amounts written, each loan counted once, with shares of the year.

macro_series.title: Macroeconomic series
macro_series.description: The monthly FRED series every macro covariate is built from, before lags.

scenarios_by_segment.title: Scenarios by segment
scenarios_by_segment.description: Twelve-month PD, and lifetime PD over 36 months under the baseline and the adverse path, weighted by the lending each profile stands for.

selection_collinear.title: Selection: collinear
selection_collinear.description: Pairs correlated beyond 0.8, reported and not resolved.

selection_correlation.title: Selection: correlation
selection_correlation.description: Exposure-weighted correlation between the continuous candidates.

selection_elimination.title: Selection: elimination
selection_elimination.description: Backward elimination, one covariate a step, and the rule that fired.

selection_fits.title: Selection: fits
selection_fits.description: Every model the selection estimated, its time, and whether it was cached.

selection_inflation.title: Selection: inflation
selection_inflation.description: Candidates removed for variance inflation above 10, in the fixed order.

selection_screening.title: Selection: screening
selection_screening.description: Each candidate beside the loan block: sign, effect, likelihood ratio.

selection_stability.title: Selection: stability
selection_stability.description: Standardised effects on the training half and on each half of the book.

term_structure_by_segment.title: PD term structure by segment
term_structure_by_segment.description: Cumulative and marginal PD over 60 months for the origination book dated to today, on the baseline path.

underwriting_by_vintage.title: Underwriting by vintage
underwriting_by_vintage.description: Quartiles of credit score, loan-to-value and debt-to-income by vintage year, sentinels removed.

vintage_curves.title: Cumulative default by vintage
vintage_curves.description: Kaplan-Meier of each vintage year on its own risk sets, from the cells.
